'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Erich Hawbaker DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Erich Hawbaker]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Der Junker
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
